summary: Distinguish replication request-head arrival from body extraction in server diagnostics

replay.detail: No graph admission, replay or exchange semantics change.

schema.detail: No persisted fields or database migration.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or digest change.

compatibility.detail: The existing INFO exchange summary adds head_received_unix_ms, body_read_complete_unix_ms and request_body_bytes. Interrupted or rejected uploads emit one INFO incomplete-body record with correlation ID, head arrival time, bytes read and error flag. Correlation IDs remain unauthenticated diagnostic input.

downtime.detail: Normal binary upgrade; no coordinated fleet restart.

manual.detail: No configuration changes or additional operator steps.

recovery.detail: Transport timeouts, retry policy, authentication and body size limits are unchanged. The new boundaries distinguish a missing request head from an interrupted upload; they do not establish a production root cause by themselves.
